name: +1 Dig For Brainrot ⛏️
desc:
Welcome to +1 Dig for Brainrots ⛏️

Dig deeper, go further, and collect as many Brainrots as you can! Use your growing digging power to reach insane depths and uncover hidden underground layers! 🌍

How to play:
🪨 Dig your way down through each zone
🧠 Collect Brainrots to earn Cash
⚡ Gain +1 Digging speed every time you progress
💵 Upgrade your Brainrots to boost your income
🏗️ Expand your mine base to unlock more storage slots

💤 Your Brainrots generate Cash even while OFFLINE!

Rebirth to multiply your cash! ♻️
